about: Orbit Watch: figures copied by hand from NASA and ESA publications, each with its source and date. Checked Nov 17, 2026. Reviewed each quarter (NASA's Orbital Debris Quarterly News) and when ESA publishes a new Space Environment Report or updates its statistics page; see docs/DATA-SOURCES.md. © 2026 Malcolm Syme · mcsyme11@gmail.com

boxScore.note: Satellite Box Score: objects in Earth orbit in the US catalogue. Spacecraft are working and dead; debris includes spent rocket bodies.
boxScore.source: NASA Orbital Debris Program Office, Orbital Debris Quarterly News, September 2026 (volume 30, issue 3)

numbers.source: ESA Space Debris Office, Space Environment Statistics ("Space debris by the numbers")
